The essential edit

Three gestures.
One ritual.

Made to layer without noise: cleanse, replenish, seal.

Cleansing Concentrate

Luminous Facial Essence

Niacinamide + rose · 30 ml

Barrier Night Balm

Morning or evening

A ritual that fits
real life.

  1. 01
    Cleanse slowly

    Massage onto dry skin, then add water until the texture turns weightless.

  2. 02
    Press in hydration

    Pat the essence into slightly damp skin. Let each layer settle.

  3. 03
    Seal what matters

    Warm a small amount of balm between fingertips and press onto dry areas.
